scope: Independent source review, finite source-to-Expand/Core+SourceMap-to-Types differential and dedicated regression re-execution. No native execution, full-workspace or performance claim.

findings: AggregateDeclarations traverses the same specialized module/item order and uses entry(name.clone()).or_insert(original_aggregate_reference), preserving first declaration selection.

The project map is built after specialization and default-helper processing, at the same project stage as the old borrowed-module list. Per-module expansion order, cumulative node/analysis limits and SourceMap validation are unchanged.
Each Expander borrows the one immutable request-local map. The standalone API still constructs its own local map once; there is no cross-request storage or mutation.

receivers.rs only removes an extra reference at the existing callable-template expansion call. Default helper ownership, public export/import identities and diagnostic source spans remain on the existing path.

For a project call, each resolving core is an unmodified clone of one core in the same immutable program. Thus D(core) union D(program) equals D(program), for both callable parameters and State binding names. BTreeSet membership and cardinality are identical despite the changed insertion traversal order.
Standalone resolve collects D(core) with no project. Each aggregates::resolve_program invocation creates a fresh set, including the separate calls before and after closure inference.

The existing Store placeholder cost depends on callable_names.len(); equal set cardinality preserves this charge as well as all contains lookups. All aggregate/enum owner indexing charges, local duplicate/member checks and function/body validation remain in their original per-module order.

No core function or declaration is mutated before the old set-construction position. Moving the uncharged collection earlier cannot change the validation data; the set is borrowed read-only through Resolver and is not reused across phases or requests.

baseline_build_provenance.note: Reused existing release libraries after a successful cargo freshness check. The five crates are the complete dependency closure; their Git tree identities and workspace manifests/Cargo.lock match 0d28a514. A later read-only check also confirmed no live source diff in those paths.

independent_differential.comparison_driver:
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

scratch = pathlib.Path('/tmp/cp10-review-toolchain-setup')
repo = pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/ac5966c4c370/zil-cp10')
baseline_repo = pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/ac5966c4c370/zil-research')
baseline = '0d28a51452f57c2cd27c1007058056c021bf3481'
candidate = sys.argv[1]
crates = ['zil-base', 'zil-ir', 'zil-syntax', 'zil-expand', 'zil-types']

def git(path, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(path), *args], text=True).strip()

assert git(repo, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == candidate
source_paths = [f'crates/{name}' for name in crates]
assert not git(repo, 'diff', '--name-only', candidate, '--', *source_paths)
assert not git(baseline_repo, 'diff', '--name-only', baseline, 'HEAD', '--', *source_paths, 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'rust-toolchain.toml')

deps = repo / 'target/debug/deps'
argv = ['rustc', '--edition=2024', '-C', 'panic=abort', str(scratch / 'probe.rs'), '-L', f'dependency={deps}']
libraries = {}
for name in crates:
    rust_name = name.replace('-', '_')
    files = list(deps.glob(f'lib{rust_name}-*.rlib'))
    assert len(files) == 1, (rust_name, files)
    lib = files[0]
    libraries[rust_name] = {'path': str(lib), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(lib.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    argv.extend(['--extern', f'{rust_name}={lib}'])
argv.extend(['-o', str(scratch / 'candidate-probe')])
built = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True)
build_record = {'candidate_commit': candidate, 'argv': argv, 'exit_code': built.returncode, 'libraries': libraries, 'stdout': built.stdout, 'stderr': built.stderr}
(scratch / 'candidate-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(build_record, indent=2) + '\n')
assert built.returncode == 0, built.stderr

run_argv = [str(scratch / 'candidate-probe'), str(repo)]
completed = subprocess.run(run_argv, capture_output=True, text=True)
(scratch / 'candidate.stdout').write_text(completed.stdout)
(scratch / 'candidate.stderr').write_text(completed.stderr)
assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr
old = [json.loads(line) for line in (scratch / 'baseline.stdout').read_text().splitlines()]
new = [json.loads(line) for line in completed.stdout.splitlines()]
assert len(old) == len(new), (len(old), len(new))
different = [{'line': i + 1, 'baseline': a, 'candidate': b} for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(old, new)) if a != b]
boundaries = [{'label': row['label'], 'n': row['n'], 'below': row['below']} for row in old if row['kind'] == 'boundary']
metadata = {
    'baseline_commit': baseline,
    'baseline_source_verification_worktree_head': git(baseline_repo, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'),
    'candidate_commit': candidate,
    'baseline_source_identity': {
        path: {'baseline_tree': git(baseline_repo, 'rev-parse', f'{baseline}:{path}'), 'build_tree': git(baseline_repo, 'rev-parse', f'HEAD:{path}')}
        for path in source_paths
    },
    'run_argv': run_argv,
    'exit_code': completed.returncode,
    'output_records': len(old),
    'mismatches': different,
    'source_cases': old[-1]['source_cases'],
    'positive_cases': old[-1]['positive_cases'],
    'budget_boundaries': boundaries,
    'bounded_api_invocations_per_side': sum(row['binary_search_queries'] + 4 for row in old if row['kind'] == 'boundary'),
}
(scratch / 'comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + '\n')
assert not different, different
print(json.dumps({key: metadata[key] for key in ['candidate_commit', 'output_records', 'mismatches', 'source_cases', 'positive_cases', 'bounded_api_invocations_per_side']}))
